latest_release.body:
[You-Get](https://you-get.org/) **0.4.1743** is now [released on PyPI](http://pypi.python.org/pypi/you-get/0.4.1743).

Please upgrade to the latest version:

``` console
$ pip install --upgrade you-get
```

## What's Changed
* [YouTube] Fix extraction
* Fix: Restore functionality of -o parameter for Miaopai downloads by @doskey in https://github.com/soimort/you-get/pull/3030
* remove imported but unsed module by @ljhcage in https://github.com/soimort/you-get/pull/3032

## New Contributors
* @doskey made their first contribution in https://github.com/soimort/you-get/pull/3030

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/soimort/you-get/compare/v0.4.1730...v0.4.1743
